messages.author: afa3a78132320260
messages.subject: Re: Boxplot
parts:
ggplot uses the ordering of the factor levels to place the boxplots along the x-axis. You should manually set the order of the levels before plotting.

Example code:
data3$Semaine <- factor(data3$Semaine, levels = c(48:53, 1:8))
ggplot(data3, aes(Semaine, LT)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_bw()

HTH,
W.
